sumInsured.title: Sum Insured
sumInsured.description: The most your policy pays, subject to its terms.

coPayment.title: Co-payment
coPayment.description: You don't pay a share of eligible claims.
coPayment.wording: No co-payment is applicable under this Policy.

deductible.title: Deductible
deductible.description: Your policy details don't mention a deductible.

periods.title: Initial waiting period
periods.description: Illness claims are not paid during this time from the start of cover.

periods.title: Pre-existing diseases
periods.description: Illnesses you had before buying the policy are covered only after this time.
periods.wording: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing disease and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with the Company.

waitingPeriods.basis: Based on your inputs, this policy was first taken on 01-Nov-2024 and renewed every year without a break
notes: Within the policy period, the waiting period shall apply afresh to the extent of sum insured increase

roomRent.title: Room rent
roomRent.wording: Up to 1% of Sum Insured per day (Rs. 10,000 per day)

limits.title: ICU charges
limits.description: Up to 2% of Sum Insured per day (₹20,000 per day) including nursing and monitoring charges
limits.wording: Up to 2% of Sum Insured per day (Rs. 20,000 per day) including nursing and monitoring charges

limits.title: Modern treatments
limits.description: Robotic surgery, immunotherapy and similar advanced treatments.

additionalBenefits.title: Before hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Tests and medicines up to 60 days before admission.

additionalBenefits.title: After hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Follow-up costs up to 90 days after discharge.

additionalBenefits.title: Daycare procedures
additionalBenefits.description: Treatments that need less than 24 hours in hospital.
additionalBenefits.wording: All day care procedures listed in Annexure

additionalBenefits.title: Ambulance
additionalBenefits.description: Covered for emergency care and road ambulance transportation up to ₹3,000 per hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.wording: Covered for emergency care and road ambulance transportation up to Rs. 3,000 per hospitalisation

additionalBenefits.title: Cashless hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: At network hospitals, the insurer pays the hospital directly.
additionalBenefits.wording: Cashless at network hospitals / reimbursement. Intimation within 24 hours of emergency or 48 hours before planned admission.

additionalBenefits.title: In-patient hospitalisation
additionalBenefits.description: Needs at least 24 hours in hospital.

additionalBenefits.title: AYUSH treatment
additionalBenefits.description: Ayurveda, Yoga, Unani, Siddha and Homeopathy treatment.

additionalBenefits.title: Organ donor expenses
additionalBenefits.description: Costs of the organ donor's surgery.

additionalBenefits.title: Restoration benefit
additionalBenefits.description: Sum insured is refilled after it is used up.

additionalBenefits.title: Health check-up
conditions: Covered as part of diagnostic procedures for hospitalisation, pre and post hospitalisation, and annual health check-up up to ₹2,500 per insured adult
additionalBenefits.wording: Covered as part of diagnostic procedures for hospitalisation, pre and post hospitalisation, and annual health check-up up to Rs. 2,500 per insured adult

special: Grace period of 30 days is available to renew the Policy; coverage is not available during the grace period
Policy issued on the basis of the proposal and declarations made by the Proposer
Any material misrepresentation shall render the Policy void
Free look period of 30 days from the date of receipt of the policy document is available for new policies
exclusions: Change-of-Gender Treatments (Excl07). Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex

Obesity / Weight Control (Excl06). Expenses related to the surgical treatment of obesity that does not fulfil the conditions specified (BMI of 40 or more, or 35 or more with severe co-morbidities, and failure of less invasive methods)
Sterility and Infertility (Excl17). Expenses related to sterility and infertility, including contraception, assisted reproduction services, gestational surrogacy and reversal of sterilisation
Refractive Error (Excl15). Expenses related to the treatment for correction of eye sight due to refractive error less than 7.5 dioptres
Substance Abuse (Excl12). Treatment for alcoholism, drug or substance abuse or any addictive condition and consequences thereof

Maternity (Excl18). Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalisation) except ectopic pregnancy, and expenses towards miscarriage or termination of pregnancy

Wellness and Rejuvenation (Excl13). Treatments received in health hydros, nature cure clinics, spas or similar establishments, or private beds registered as a nursing home attached to such establishments, or where admission is arranged wholly or partly for domestic reasons

Hazardous or Adventure Sports (Excl09). Expenses related to any treatment necessitated due to participation as a professional in hazardous or adventure sports, including para-jumping, rock climbing, mountaineering, rafting, motor racing, horse racing, scuba diving and deep-sea diving

Cosmetic or Plastic Surgery (Excl08). Expenses for cosmetic or plastic surgery or any treatment to change appearance unless for reconstruction following an accident, burn(s) or cancer or as part of medically necessary treatment to remove a direct and immediate health risk to the insured. For this to be considered a medical necessity, it must be certified by the attending Medical Practitioner. Aesthetic procedures including rhinoplasty, blepharoplasty, liposuction and abdominoplasty undertaken to improve appearance are not payable

Rest Cure, Rehabilitation and Respite Care (Excl05). Expenses related to any admission primarily for enforced bed rest and not for receiving treatment, including custodial care and services for assistance with activities of daily living

Unproven Treatments (Excl16). Expenses related to any unproven treatment, services and supplies for or in connection with any treatment. Unproven treatments are treatments, procedures or supplies that lack significant medical documentation to support their effectiveness
Breach of Law (Excl10). Expenses for treatment directly arising from or consequent upon any Insured Person committing or attempting to commit a breach of law with criminal intent

Dietary Supplements (Excl14). Dietary supplements and substances that can be purchased without prescription, including vitamins, minerals and organic substances, unless prescribed by a medical practitioner as part of hospitalisation

War, invasion, acts of foreign enemies, nuclear, chemical or biological contamination; out-patient treatment; dental treatment unless requiring hospitalisation due to an accident; external durable medical equipment; treatment taken outside India; and all non-medical items specified in Annexure I

Excluded Providers (Excl11). Expenses incurred towards treatment in any hospital or by any Medical Practitioner or any other provider specifically excluded by the Company and disclosed on its website, except in case of life threatening situations

Investigation and Evaluation (Excl04). Expenses related to any admission primarily for diagnostics and evaluation purposes only are excluded. Any diagnostic expenses which are not related or not incidental to the current diagnosis and treatment are excluded
